content:
After updating, I found some change in API.
MvPolynomial.scalarRTensorAlgEquiv seems swap the tensor and changed scalar. I observe that this makes it identical to MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv?
Beside this, may I ask for s reason of this change? Thanks
Can you find the PR that does it?
It is #38714 making the final edition, but it edited the file quite a lot sorry I am not able to know whether there are earilier ones. But I am quite sure this happened in the last two weeks.
hmmm, I think I remember an earlier one, let me see.
No OK, it's maybe that one. So you are saying that the tensor was on the other side? cc @Yaël Dillies
Yes, originally on the other side, also having a different scalar if I didn't remember wrong. (I am not saying it is neccesary, but now the identical two is a bit confusing
Yes I turned the tensor around to generalise to heterobasic tensor product. The names are a bit all over the place so it is possible I accidentally duplicated things
